verdict.rationale: Firebase's own Local Emulator Suite provides an isolated local environment for testing against Firestore, Security Rules, and other services without touching production data, including Test SDK helpers for loading rules and flushing data. Separately, the official MCP server lets agents work with Cloud Firestore and SQL Connect, and Gemini can generate schemas, but nothing in the evidence connects the agent to the emulator or to a branch workflow. missing for 10: database branching or cloud preview environments for schema changes, documented agent/MCP control of the emulator for schema testing, a schema migration and promotion-to-production workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.
